title: Amazon Web Services India net profit jumps over 10-fold to Rs 242 cr in FY26 - The Economic Times
text:
In FY26, Amazon Web Services India experienced a remarkable increase in its consolidated net profit, soaring over tenfold to reach Rs 242.8 crore, while consolidated revenue from operations also experienced a growth of about 21 percent, hitting Rs 20,225.6 crore. However, the standalone net profit faced a downturn of approximately 14 percent, despite a standalone revenue increase of 21.4 percent, totaling Rs 20,225.6 crore.
